Road axes, road classification, tonnage, traffic sections, projects, cycle routes, districts and locality names. Not passenger-line geometry.

sources.refreshPolicy: Pinned September 2026 archival study. A new timetable, boundary, geometry or routing policy requires a full rebuild and coverage audit.

census.boundaryRule: At least one original GTFS call coordinate in the unsimplified 2026 Valais canton polygon. Full journey retained, including every call outside Valais. No operator whitelist.
census.allYearMeaning: All trip records in the pinned annual archive, including records inactive on both validation dates; not a claim of operating every day.
